operations.name: projects.describe
operations.description: Read Project detail, lifecycle and reference health. Supply the Project identifier through --aggregate-id. Safe metadata is the default; descriptive metadata requires separate permission and a durable audit.

operations.name: projects.list
operations.description: List authorized Projects with one snapshot. Use payload paging: default 50, maximum 200; continue with the opaque cursor and unchanged filters and authority. Descriptive metadata requires a separate permission and durable audit.

operations.name: projects.trace-attachments
operations.description: Trace unselected advisory Project candidates from at most 32 opaque owner references, counted before deduplication. File mapping is unsupported. Coverage and freshness never grant selection or confirmation authority.

operations.name: projects.trace-conversation
operations.description: Trace unselected advisory Project candidates from an authorized committed Conversation. Coverage and freshness are explicit; suggestions never authorize selection, context or confirmation.
